clue.text: Greek Christmas with passing of year was what GS advocated

parts.note: Homer, the Greek epic poet of the Iliad and Odyssey

indicators.note: the passing of something means it goes away, so this letter drops out of the festive word

parts.note: Yule is an old name for Christmas

explanation.surface: A Greek celebrating Christmas as the year ends is somehow linked to a Victorian statesman's policy.
explanation.walkthrough: GS is Gladstone, the Victorian Liberal prime minister who championed self-government for Ireland. 'with passing of' removes Y from YULE, leaving ULE.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladstone's great unfulfilled cause was devolved self-government for Ireland, known as the Irish Home Rule policy.

clue.text: Element getting mother so upset, hanging round centre of Devizes

explanation.walkthrough: Devizes is a market town in Wiltshire, England; its seven letters have a single central one.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmium is a metallic chemical element, the densest naturally occurring one.

clue.text: S: Actors dine out

explanation.surface: Actors go out to dinner together.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle remembers GS, Gladstone: clues marked S: are defined by STONE and clues marked G: by GLAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A draconite is a legendary gem said to be taken from a dragon's head, so it counts as a stone.
